project_info.theme: European castle morning tea lifestyle portrait
project_info.color_palette: white linen, warm gold, cream, soft green garden, gold-framed art

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with a fresh regal presence, sun-kissed natural skin texture, loose voluminous waves, and a playful sophisticated gaze. She sits upright in a grand canopied bed with white linen, holding a porcelain teacup at her lips. She wears a vintage white lace nightgown with silk ribbons and a delicate gold locket.

items: large French windows looking over a misty garden
antique oil paintings in gold frames
fresh white peonies in a crystal vase
vertical bed portrait with no text, logo, or watermark

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: direct soft golden-hour morning sun through French windows
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: warm ethereal room glow, soft shadows, controlled highlights on silk and lace, backlit hair

technical_specs.render_style: 50mm f/2 lifestyle photograph with natural colors
technical_specs.color_treatment: fine grain, soft-focus background, warm dynamic range, natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 high-end lifestyle portrait of an adult woman in a sunlit French chateau or Italian villa bedroom. She sits upright in a grand canopied bed with white linen, holding a porcelain teacup at her lips with a playful sophisticated gaze. She has sun-kissed natural skin texture and loose voluminous waves, and wears a vintage white lace nightgown with silk ribbons plus a delicate gold locket. Place a silver breakfast tray on her lap, large French windows opening to a misty garden, antique gold-framed oil paintings, and fresh white peonies in a crystal vase. Use soft direct golden-hour morning sun for an ethereal warm room glow, soft shadows, controlled highlights on silk and lace, and backlit hair. Shoot with a 50mm f/2 lifestyle-photography feel, natural colors, fine grain, soft-focus background, and peaceful old-money elegance.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, bright artificial light, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, bedroom, and tableware references may be attached. Preserve adult identity, white lace nightgown, tea pose, canopy bed, breakfast tray, French-window morning light, and old-money setting; do not change the supplied outfit when a wardrobe reference is attached.

changes: Changed age-specific 23-year-old wording to adult woman.
Replaced alluring wording with a playful sophisticated gaze while preserving the nightgown, tea pose, bed, and morning old-money mood.
